title: gate misses /usr/bin/time as a wrapper after a redirect or assignment
detail: After a redirect or an assignment, 'time' is not bash's reserved word but the external /usr/bin/time, which runs its arguments: '> o time rm a' and 'a=1 time rm a' remove a. Neither v0.238.8 nor the one-bash-lexer reader reads 'rm a' there (v0.238.8 read '> o time >! rm a' only by accident via '>!'). Same family as fb-0e678051f98e (sudo/env/xargs wrappers); fix with the wrapper work on the bash reader. Found by the round-4 token sweep of one-bash-lexer.
